title: Kernel comparison for the dual of a finite free constant matrix
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. For nonnegative integers $n,m$, let $g:\Lambda^m\to\Lambda^n$ be a linear map. Let $C$ be the constant coefficient sheaf functor on the small étale site of $X$ [def-constructible-constant], and let $D(F)=\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(F,\Lambda_X)$, where $\Lambda_X$ is the tensor unit. Write $g^\vee:(\Lambda^n)^\vee\to(\Lambda^m)^\vee$ for precomposition with $g$. Then $\ker(D(C(g)))\cong C(\ker(g^\vee))$ as sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules.

proof.text: Apply the auxiliary finite-free kernel comparison theorem, then map the categorical module-kernel isomorphism through the constant sheaf functor.
Use ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer for the map induced by g.dualMap; its underlying linear map is definitionally g.dualMap, yielding the stated explicit kernel.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_constantFiniteMatrixDualKernelIso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (n m : ℕ) (g : (Fin m → Λ) →ₗ[Λ] (Fin n → Λ)) :
    Nonempty (kernel
      ((MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj
        (𝟙_ (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))).map
          ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map
            (ModuleCat.ofHom g)).op) ≅
      (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of Λ (LinearMap.ker g.dualMap)))
